config.intro_titulo: How the CRM behaves in this company.
config.intro_aviso: The values change how the whole base is classified in the next calculation, and how many messages go out.
config.seccao_frequencia_titulo: How often you can contact a customer
config.seccao_frequencia_explicacao: Applies to all campaigns combined. Once a customer reaches the limit, they stop receiving messages until the window passes — even if another campaign includes them.
config.limite_janela_ajuda: After this time, the count starts again.
config.seccao_perda_titulo: When a customer starts to slip away
config.seccao_perda_explicacao: Measured against each customer's own habit, not in fixed days. At 2x, someone who buys every 10 days becomes at risk at 20 — and someone who buys every 90 days only at 180.
config.factor_risco_ajuda: How many times their usual interval.
config.factor_inactivo_ajuda: Beyond this, winning them back costs far more.
config.intervalo_minimo_ajuda: Stops someone who buys almost every day from triggering alerts over a weekend.
config.seccao_uma_compra_explicacao: Without two purchases there is no interval to measure, so these use fixed days.
config.dias_risco_sem_habito_ajuda: Before this, they count as a recent customer.
config.dias_inactivo_sem_habito_ajuda: Bought once and never came back.
config.seccao_medicao_explicacao: How long after a message a purchase still counts as its result. Long windows make any campaign look successful.
config.janela_conversao_rotulo: A purchase counts as a conversion within
config.janela_conversao_ajuda: Counted from the time of sending.
config.seccao_mayra_explicacao: Windows she proposes when recommending a campaign. They can still be changed on each campaign.
config.supressao_em_risco_ajuda: Do not send to anyone who bought in this period.
config.supressao_inactivo_ajuda: Same, for those who have not bought for a long time.
config.pontos_por_metical_ajuda: 0.01 gives 1 point for every 100 MT spent.
config.valor_do_ponto_ajuda: As a discount, when the customer uses them.
config.minimo_resgate_ajuda: Below this the customer accumulates but cannot spend.
config.fidelizacao_explicacao: How much customers earn by buying, and what that is worth when they redeem.
config.aviso_desligada: While off, nobody earns or redeems points. Current balances are kept and become available again if you switch it back on.
config.simul_de_desconto: in discount — {{percentagem}}% of the purchase value.
config.simul_resgate: Can only be redeemed from {{minimo}} points, i.e. after spending MT {{valor}}.
config.aviso_custo_alto: You are giving back more than a fifth of every sale in points. Make sure the margin can take it.
config.canais_explicacao: None selected means every channel the system can deliver through.
config.rodape: Settings apply from the next segment calculation — it runs every night, or when you request it in the Segments tab.

fusao.subtitulo: Customers who share a phone number, email or NUIT — they may be the same person.
fusao.um_ja_fundido: One of the two has already been merged into another customer. The server will refuse this merge.
fusao.escolha_qual_fica: Choose which one stays. The other is absorbed: its sales, points and identities move to the one that stays, and it disappears from the customer list.
fusao.rejeitar_explicacao_b: the same person — for example, a family phone shared by two different people. The pair will not be suggested again.
fusao.irreversivel: Irreversible. The absorbed customer disappears from the customer list.
fusao.motivo_exemplo: E.g. confirmed by phone with the customer

segmentos.dim_recorrencia_desc: How long since they last bought, against each customer's habit
segmentos.dim_valor_desc: How much they spend, compared with other customers
segmentos.fixar_explicacao: Saves who belongs to the segment today. The segment keeps changing; the audience does not — this is how a campaign later knows who it was sent to.
segmentos.vazio_titulo: No segments have been calculated yet.
segmentos.vazio_explicacao: Classification runs automatically in the early hours. To see this company's segments now, calculate them now.
segmentos.classificacao_noites: Customers are classified automatically every night.
segmentos.sem_clientes: This segment has no customers at the moment.
segmentos.audiencias_explicacao: A segment's composition saved on a given day

campanhas.resultado_sem_consentimento_ajuda: The customer has not agreed to be contacted through this channel.
campanhas.resultado_sem_contacto_ajuda: The customer has no phone number or email for this channel.
campanhas.resultado_ja_comprou_ajuda: The message is no longer relevant: the customer has already bought.
campanhas.resultado_limite_frequencia_ajuda: The customer has already received the maximum number of messages for this period.
campanhas.resultado_canal_indisponivel_ajuda: Sending through this channel is not configured in the system.
campanhas.entrega_aceite_ajuda: The provider accepted it. It is not yet known whether it arrived.
campanhas.entrega_enviada_ajuda: Handed to the network operator, on its way to the customer.
campanhas.entrega_nao_entregue_ajuda: The operator could not deliver it.
campanhas.nome_interno: Internal name. The customer does not see it.
campanhas.nenhum_segmento: No segment has customers. Calculate the segments first.
campanhas.no_grupo: {{n}} customer(s) in the group. Only those who agreed to be contacted through this channel will receive it.
campanhas.mayra_sem_historico_dica: These customers have not bought anything yet: MAYRA has no history to write from.
campanhas.mayra_dica: MAYRA reads what these customers buy and writes three options.
campanhas.mayra_nao_consegue: MAYRA cannot write for this group.
campanhas.mayra_nao_consegue_explicacao: These customers signed up but have not bought anything yet — there is no purchase history to write from. Write the message yourself, or choose a group with purchases.
campanhas.texto_exemplo: Hello {{nome}}, we have news this week.
campanhas.nome_substituido: is replaced by the customer's first name.
campanhas.nao_enviar_comprou: Do not send to anyone who bought in the last
campanhas.evita_insistir: Avoids pestering people who have bought in the meantime. Leave empty to send to everyone.
campanhas.criada_em_rascunho: The campaign is created as a draft. It only goes out when you confirm sending.
campanhas.confirmar_entregas_dica: Asks the provider what happened to the messages. It also runs by itself every 10 minutes.
campanhas.ainda_nao_enviada: It has not been sent yet.
campanhas.enviar_mensagem: Send "{{nome}}"? The messages go out immediately.
campanhas.cancelar_mensagem: Cancel this campaign? It cannot be reactivated.
campanhas.mayra_sem_dados: MAYRA has nothing to work with yet
campanhas.intro: Messages to a customer segment, with consent checked before every send.
campanhas.vazio_explicacao: A campaign sends the same message to every customer in a segment — only to those who agreed to be contacted.

visao.estado_em_risco_desc: Has not bought for longer than is usual for this customer
visao.estado_inactivo_desc: Has not bought for much longer than is usual for this customer
visao.identidade_duplicado: If it already belongs to another customer, a suspected duplicate is created for review.
visao.erro_carregar: Could not load the customer record.
visao.desligar_mensagem: Unlink this identity from the customer?
visao.fid_desligada: Loyalty is switched off in this company
visao.fid_pode_usar: Can be used at the till
visao.fid_porque_exemplo: It is recorded and visible here
visao.fid_ajuda: Positive adds, negative removes. The balance never drops below zero.
visao.previsao: Going by their average, they should be back within {{n}} day(s)
visao.previsao_baixa: still too few purchases to be sure
visao.sem_identidades: No identity linked. The customer is only recognised by the details on record.
visao.consentimentos_nota: Marketing by channel. Account and billing notices do not depend on these consents.
visao.sem_actividade: No activity recorded yet. Purchases will appear here as they happen.
